system.description: Choose a Craving: Mesmerizing (dazed, MP-primary), Pestilent (weak, HP-primary; printed Miasmic), Terrifying (shaken, MP-primary) or Inevitable (slow, HP-primary). First infliction of its status on an unmarked creature each scene marks it and pays (SL × 5) primary or (SL × 3) secondary; at SL3+ the Craving's second status also triggers. Marks vanish at scene's end. Undead and constructs are not meals (house ruling — not in print).
